detail.longDescription: The Astrophysical and Cosmological Relativity (ACR) department at the @ mpi_grav in Potsdam invites applications for several postdoctoral appointments, offered at different levels according to experience and seniority, with durations from two to five years. ℹ️  https://www. aei.mpg.de/1513474/acr-postdoc -2027 📅 Deadline for full consideration: 23 November 2026, including receipt of reference letters; anticipated start date: fall 2027 – General appointments in the ACR department, at junior and senior postdoctoral level. – Several positions within the ERC Synergy Grant “Making Sense of the Unexpected in the Gravitational-Wave Sky”. – One position within the Simons Collaboration on Black Holes and Strong Gravity. – One position within the Center of Gravity, shared between the AEI (two years) and the Niels Bohr Institute in Copenhagen (two years). # Postdoc # Academia # FediHire # Physics # Research # ScienceJobs # Potsdam
